st.t: Talk to Martin in the Draynor Market.
s: Now that I think about it, you're right!

st.t: Talk to 5 farmers, then return to Martin in Draynor Village. The recommended 5 are: Frizzy in Port Sarim. Elstan north west of Draynor. Heskel in Falador Park. Treznor south of Varrock Castle. Dreven south of Varrock, next to the Champions' Guild. If you don't already have secateurs, you can buy them from Sarah in South Falador Farm.
s: Are you a member of the Group of Advanced Gardeners?

st.t: Return to Martin in the Draynor Market.
Wield your dramen or lunar staff and enter the shed door in the middle of Lumbridge Swamp to travel to Zanaris.
Talk to the Fairy Godfather in the Throne Room, just south of where you arrive in Zanaris.
Talk to Fairy Nuff in north west Zanaris.
Climb to the top floor of the Dark Wizards' Tower west of Falador and talk to Zandar.
Dig with a spade on the grave behind Draynor Manor, north of the building but inside the fence, for a skull.
Talk to Malignius Mortifer west of Port Sarim.
s: I need help with fighting a Tanglefoot.
I was asking you about fighting a Tanglefoot...

i: Draynor skull or a spade to get it

st.t: Get the 3 items Mortifer told you to get: your quest journal lists them. If any of them is food (jangerberries, a lime, edible seaweed or a king worm), bring spares or a filled druid pouch: ghasts in Mort Myre can rot it.
i: 3 items Mortifer told you to get

st.t: Take the Shades of Mort'ton minigame teleport, go west, then follow the winding path north over the bridge to the Grotto in the south of Mort Myre. Wear your ghostspeak amulet and enter the Grotto.
i: 3 items Mortifer told you to get

st.t: Wield your dramen or lunar staff and enter the shed door in the middle of Lumbridge Swamp to travel to Zanaris, ready to fight the Tanglefoot.
Go to the Cosmic Altar in the south of Zanaris and squeeze through the gap in the west wall to enter the Tanglefoot's lair.
Kill the large Tanglefoot with the Magic Secateurs. You can flinch it on a corner. Pick up the queen's secateurs it drops.
Talk to the Fairy Godfather to finish the quest.
